"""Large-R sanity: DP frontier must beat every random legal layout's frontier."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import planner, ref

def random_layout(R, starts, rng):
    def rec(lo, span):
        if span<=8 and (span<2 or rng.random()<0.35): return ('leaf',lo,span,())
        m=rng.randrange(2,min(9,span)+1)
        cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(lo+1,lo+span),m-1))
        b=(lo,)+tuple(cuts)+(lo+span,)
        return ('node',lo,span,tuple(rec(x,y-x) for x,y in zip(b,b[1:])))
    return rec(0,R)

def layout_frontier(tree, starts, q, bursts, cap, hit, miss, decode, R):
    qsum=[0]*(R+1)
    for i in range(R): qsum[i+1]=qsum[i]+q[i]
    def T(lo,hi):
        t=0
        for w,runs in bursts:
            if any(lo<=r<hi for r in runs): t+=w
        return t
    nodes=[]
    def walk(nd):
        kind,lo,span,kids=nd
        spread=starts[lo+span-1]-starts[lo]
        modes=[0]
        if spread<(1<<64): modes.append(1)
        if spread<(1<<32): modes.append(2)
        best=None
        for mode in modes:
            if kind=='leaf':
                p=ref._pages(32+span*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=span
            else:
                p=ref._pages(32+4*len(kids)+(len(kids)-1)*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=len(kids)-1
            b=(keys+ref.LANES[mode]-1)//ref.LANES[mode]+decode[mode]
            t=T(lo,lo+span); qq=qsum[lo+span]-qsum[lo]
            base=p*miss*t+b*qq; gain=p*(miss-hit)*t
            cand=(base,gain,p)
            if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
        nodes.append(best)
        for k in kids: walk(k)
    walk(tree)
    base=sum(n[0] for n in nodes); pages=1+ref._pages(4*R)+sum(n[2] for n in nodes)
    g=[0]*(cap+1)
    for _,gain,p in nodes:
        for c in range(cap,p-1,-1):
            if g[c-p]+gain>g[c]: g[c]=g[c-p]+gain
    for c in range(1,cap+1): g[c]=max(g[c],g[c-1])
    return [(base-g[c], pages) for c in range(cap+1)]

def main():
    seed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
    rounds=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 20
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    leaf,inte=None,None
    bad=0
    t0=time.time()
    for it in range(rounds):
        R=rng.randrange(7,65)
        starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<rng.choice([30,64,128])) for _ in range(R-1)})
        while len(starts)<R: starts.append(starts[-1]+rng.randrange(1,1<<30))
        starts=starts[:R]
        q=[rng.randrange(0,50) for _ in range(R)]
        bursts=[(rng.randrange(1,1000), sorted({rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,6))}))
                for _ in range(rng.randrange(0,6))]
        cap=rng.randrange(0,13); hit=rng.randrange(1,17); miss=rng.randrange(hit,257)
        decode=[rng.randrange(0,17) for _ in range(3)]
        lo,io=planner.option_tables(decode)
        t=time.time()
        plans=planner.plan_version(R,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode,lo,io)
        dt=time.time()-t
        mine=[(p.work,p.pages+0) for p in plans]
        for _ in range(12):
            tree=random_layout(R,starts,rng)
            rf=layout_frontier(tree,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode,R)
            for c in range(cap+1):
                if mine[c] > rf[c]:
                    bad+=1
                    print("DP WORSE than random layout!", dict(R=R,cap=cap,hit=hit,miss=miss,decode=decode,c=c))
                    print(" mine",mine); print(" rand",rf); break
            if bad: break
        if bad: break
        if dt>8: print("slow", R, "%.1fs"%dt)
    print("rounds",rounds,"bad",bad,"%.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
main()
